InitResources holds Vector3 locals (pos, base), and types.h gives Vector3 an inline destructor, so the compiler emits its own copy of the four-byte bx lr body. The ROM homes it in arm9; this copy is a duplicate and is discarded by text-only isolation.

The out-of-line destructor is the key function, so this TU emits the vtable. Public address point ov063:0x0211ea88 is in .data, outside the licensed text span 0x0211c600..0x0211d270. D1 and D0 store this vptr; text-only production discards the emitted copy and retains cartridge data.
